description: Main frontend source file for a Flutter app that implements a dating filter interface with custom theme styling. It includes app setup, theme configuration, filter controls, data fetching, and results display.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget setting the Ocean Professional theme and providing the main filter page.

classes.name: CanonicalOption
classes.description: Represents a user-facing label and machine key for filter options.

classes.name: FilterPreferences
classes.description: Data class holding filter criteria with a method to build URL query parameters.

classes.name: HairColor
classes.description: Enum for hair color options used in filters.

classes.name: FiltersPage
classes.description: Main page allowing users to select filters, apply them, and view matching results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, loads environment variables and runs the app.

methods.name: _oceanProScheme
methods.description: Defines the custom Ocean Professional color palette based on brightness.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Builds ThemeData with custom colorScheme and styling for app components.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the root app widget, setting themes and home page.
